conditions.label: borderline personality disorder

modalities.evidence: Participants performed the Cyberball social exclusion task

output.population: Twenty people with borderline personality disorder (ages 20–51) recruited from outpatient and support services, plus sixteen age- and sex-matched community controls
output.summary: fMRI during the Cyberball social exclusion task in people with borderline personality disorder recruited in Edinburgh and in age- and sex-matched community controls, with SCID-II diagnoses and questionnaire measures of symptoms and childhood trauma.
